about_the_game:
Terra Factoria is a Relaxing Automation Roguelike with city-builder elements. Build a satisfying chain of resource production to get rich and expand your city.

In Terra Factoria, you must make difficult decisions about which resources to produce, and how to optimize your production pipeline.

Can you last until day 100? 

Build An Assembly Line

Chain together the buildings in your empire to merge and upgrade resources! These resources provide gold which you can use to further expand your city. 

Expand Your Empire

Make impactful decisions about which buildings to add to your city, each with their unique strengths and strategies!

 

Spend Your Gold Wisely

Purchase Relics and Items in the shop that change the rules and unlock new strategies. Manage your economy to pay ever-increasing taxes. How long will your empire last?
